law_name: Copyright Act, 2004 (Act No. 10 of 2004)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Commons cites s. 21(1); section number conflicts with WIPO table of contents, unverified); applied art 25 years; audiovisual, sound recordings, photographs 50 years

enforcement_body: UNKNOWN (Act s. 79 provides a Collecting Society of The Gambia; no copyright office identified) (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne in force 7 Mar 1993 (WIPO notification 142); WTO since 23 Sep 1996 (Commons). Search budget ran out before exceptions, digital and registration articles were found.

law_name: Copyright Code approved by Decree-Law No. 46.980 (Portuguese colonial code, 1966; WIPO lists publication 1972)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Commons summary; article not seen) (unconfirmed)
notes: Berne (Paris Act) accession deposited 18 Apr 1991, in force 22 Jul 1991. A 2025 draft copyright law hosted by OAPI exists; no evidence it was enacted. TRIPS/WCT/WPPT not checked.

law_name: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic No. 6 of 14 January 1998 on Copyright and Related Rights (as amended, incl. Law No. 14 of 21 Jan 2014 and Law No. 42 of 9 Mar 2017)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 27(1); joint works from death of last surviving co-author; anonymous/pseudonymous works 50 years from 1 January after publication)
author_rights: Economic rights and personal non-property (moral) rights
moral_rights: Personal non-property rights recognized (articles and duration not seen) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Free-use exceptions (judicial/administrative reproduction, ephemeral recordings, computer programs); 2017 amendments broadened exceptions for libraries, archives, education and persons with print disabilities (Marrakesh implementation), incl. inter-library supply

enforcement_body: State Agency of Intellectual Property and Innovation (Kyrgyzpatent)
notes: Berne in force 8 Jul 1999 (Notification 202); WCT ratified 10 Sep 1998; WPPT accession 15 May 2002, in force 15 Aug 2002 (Notification 36); WTO member since 20 Dec 1998; Marrakesh in force 15 Aug 2017. Copyright law forms part of Civil Code framework. No 2024-2026 replacement found.

law_name: Law No. 312 on Copyright and Related Rights (approved 6 Jul 1999, La Gaceta Nos. 166-167 of 31 Aug/1 Sep 1999), amended by Law No. 577 of 16 Mar 2006; consolidated text approved 25 Jun 2020 (La Gaceta No. 232, 16 Dec 2020)

moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (articles and duration not seen) (unconfirmed)

fair_use_exceptions: Specific exceptions incl. library exceptions (limited application per IFLA); article numbers not seen (unconfirmed)

law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Protection and Literary and Artistic Works Act, 2013
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Protection and Literary and Artistic Works Act 2013, s. 10(1)(b), counted from 1 January after death, s. 10(3)); audiovisual: 50 years from making available; photographs/applied art: 25 years
fair_use_exceptions: Specific exceptions (not fair use/fair dealing): education, quotation, news reporting, library photocopying (approx. Arts. 26-32; article range differs by source)
notes: Adopted 7 Jan 2013; repeals 1996 Copyright Act and 2001 Literary and Artistic Works law. Full text not read.

law_name: Law on Supporting the Rights of Authors, Composers, Artists and Researchers (Copyright Law), 2008 (Decree No. 54)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Law on Support of the Rights of Authors, Composers, Artists and Researchers 2008; joint works: 50 years after death of last author; pseudonymous: 50 years from first publication; unpublished: 50 years from fixation; Afghan calendar)
moral_rights: Moral rights of authors protected (Art. 1; dedicated chapter)
notes: 7 chapters, 49 articles; includes protection of national folklore. Adopted 21 July 2008; WIPO Lex lists 2008 as latest version.

law_name: Ordinance No. 2010-95 of 23 December 2010 on Copyright, Neighbouring Rights and Traditional Cultural Expressions
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Ordinance No. 2010-95, art. 28, which repealed the 1993 law's life + 50); anonymous works: publication + 70 years; applied art: creation + 25 years
moral_rights: Moral rights perpetual, inalienable and transmissible to heirs (Art. 8)
enforcement_body: Niger Copyright Office (Bureau nigerien du droit d'auteur, BNDA)
notes: Replaced Ordinance No. 93-027 of 30 March 1993 (repealed). BNDA statutes date from Decree 96-434 of 1996. Niger is an OAPI member but 2010 ordinance is national law.

law_name: Law No. 048-2019/AN of 12 November 2019 on the Protection of Literary and Artistic Property
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (Law No. 048-2019/AN on literary and artistic property, which repealed Law No. 032-99/AN; exact article not seen)
enforcement_body: Burkinabe Copyright Bureau (Bureau burkinabe du droit d'auteur, BBDA)
notes: Promulgated by Decree 2019-1275/PRES on 23 Dec 2019; repeals Law 032-99/AN. Covers copyright, neighbouring rights and traditional cultural expressions. Full text not read.

law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Protection Act 1996 (listed by Wikimedia Commons as main law; may be inherited Sudanese law - unverified)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (inherited Sudanese Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Protection Act 1996, s. 13(2); photographs/audiovisual: 25 years from publication); no post-independence South Sudanese law confirmed (unconfirmed)
notes: Copyright Bill being fast-tracked by Ministry of Culture (late 2025); no new act found; an undated KEI note lists South Sudan as outside WIPO and Berne; no WIPO Lex or treaty record found for South Sudan

law_name: Law No. L/2019/0028/AN of 7 June 2019 on Literary and Artistic Property (replaced Law 043/APN/CP/80 of 1980); implementing decree of 20 June 2022

notes: WPPT accession 25 Feb 2002, in force 25 May 2002 (WIPO notification WPPT 33); WCT in force 25 May 2002 per WIPO 2002 status list; TRIPS from WTO member list; Berne not verified; OAPI link not verified

law_name: Law No. 1/87 of 29 July 1987 on Copyright and Neighbouring Rights; the Bangui Agreement (revised 1999), Annex VII, also applies as Gabon is an OAPI member

law_name: Copyright Order No. 13 of 1989; Copyright Regulations 2015 (LN 139 of 2015)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Copyright Order 1989, Order No. 13 of 1989, s. 13(1); joint works s. 13(2)); photographs/applied art: creation + 25 years; anonymous: publication + 50 years

law_name: Copyright Act 1911 (UK) as extended to Palestine by Order in Council of 21 March 1924, with the Copyright Ordinance 1924 (Mandate-era law, never replaced; a 2013 draft Palestinian copyright law was not adopted because the Legislative Council was suspended)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (UK Copyright Act 1911 as applied in Palestine); posthumous works: publication + 50 years
digital_protection: None identified: the 1911 Act lacks protection for digital works; only the unadopted 2013 draft partly covers digital works
notes: Situation is unclear (Commons): the 1924 Ordinance is assumed to apply in PA-controlled areas; under Jordanian rule (1948-67) the West Bank reportedly applied the Ottoman Authors' Rights Act 1910 (life + 30 years); WIPO Lex files the 1924 Ordinance under Israel; Mandate Palestine joined Berne (1908 text) on 21 March 1924 via the UK, but current State of Palestine membership not confirmed; nothing found on Gaza specifically

law_name: Decree-Law No. 1/2009 of 27 April 2009 on the Revision of Copyright Law (amended by Decree-Law No. 2/2017)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (photographs and applied art 25 years from creation; anonymous works 50 years from publication)
registration_required: No (no registration requirement per national law summary)

law_name: Law on Copyright and Neighboring Rights of 10 June 1999

law_name: Law No. 491 of 24 November 1948 on the protection of literary and artistic works (as amended to Law No. 1.313 of 29 June 2006)

law_name: Law No. 8 of 25 January 1991 on copyright (amended by Laws No. 63/1997 and 43/1998)

law_name: Law No. 08/L-205 on Copyright and Related Rights (in force 27 October 2023; repealed Law No. 04/L-065 of 2011)

law_name: Copyright Act, 1998 (Chapter 323), consolidated through Act No. 2 of 2004 (LRO 1/2010)

law_name: Law No. 94-036 of 18 September 1995 on Literary and Artistic Property

law_name: Law of 19 May 1999 on Copyright and Related Rights (Copyright Act, URG), LGBl. 1999 No. 160; consolidated 1 November 2021

notes: General term in Art. 33(1) was not seen in the URG text; only the 2014 amendment of Art. 33(4). Berne since 1931 (Commons); WCT in force 30 April 2007 (WIPO notification); WPPT same date (IRIS); WTO since 1 Sept 1995 (Commons). Implementing Decree LGBl. 1999 No. 253.
